tasks.answer: No dedicated special-passenger (特殊旅客) component exists in the catalog. The closest general component that serves the special-passenger booking detail page role is bookings.TravelerBookingDetailScreen (export TravelerBookingDetailScreen, import '@/features/traveler-bookings/booking-detail-screen'), a feature-layer traveler booking detail screen providing status transitions, evaluations and media; required prop: bookId. Caveat: this is a general traveler booking detail, NOT a special-passenger-specific page - it has no special-passenger concepts (e.g. wheelchair/UM/medical/assistance service fields or SSR/SSR-style special-service sections), so special-passenger content must be built on top of it (composition/wrapping) or handled separately. Its feature layer is status 'experimental' with reuse scope 'module' owned by 'bookings', and it is permission-gated (actions) and requires query + router providers.
